notes: The italic *namely* is `added`: no object marker and no conjunction stands at the head of this appositional verse, so rule 16's limit governs.
The supplied determiner of *the five lords* goes to the noun and not to the numeral, as rule 15 directs.
`הַלְּבָנוֹן`'s article is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing *mount Lebanon* with no *the* (rule 29).
